images.prompt: Natural night photograph of one small wooden rowboat moored beside a stone canal edge, viewed diagonally from above. The boat lies from lower left toward upper right, with one pair of oars resting inside. A single warm lamp on the opposite bank reflects in gently rippled dark water. Light rain, realistic low-light exposure, no people. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Complete composition with breathing room. Natural photography and realistic light; no text, logo, watermark, or existing graphic treatment.

review.reason: Natural rainy night canal photograph with a complete connected boat hull, exactly two visible oars and a coherent mooring rope. Warm lamp/reflection, rain and wet-bank lighting are believable; no artificial flow effect, text or watermark.

images.actual_source_analysis: One narrow wooden rowboat is moored diagonally beside a wet stone canal edge at right during rain at night. The near pointed bow lies at lower left of the boat, while the far end points toward upper right. Two long wooden oars rest parallel across the boat interior with broad blades near lower center-right and handles toward the far end. Several transverse wooden seats and interior ribs are visible. A rope runs from a metal fitting on the near bow toward a mooring ring on the lower-right bank. One bright warm streetlamp stands on the opposite bank at upper left beneath a leafy tree, and casts a long gold reflection down the water. A stone retaining wall, hydrangea-like flowers and dark foliage extend into the right distance. Rain streaks and circular ripples are visible. The complete boat and both oars remain in the frame; no people or text are visible.
